requirement: The required service/topic radio choice must be genuinely enforced on the WordPress target; source visible copy must not change.
shared_form_constraint: MetForm33 is shared by multiple pages. Page272-only scope forbids changing the shared Form33 configuration globally merely to satisfy this page unless the change is separately authorized/proven safe for every owner.

native_radio_contract.frontend_effect: Radio widget maps mf_input_required=yes to required=true in its frontend validation configuration and renders the required-label marker.

server_path_audit.finding: The generic PHP validator uses mf_input_required to decide whether an empty non-required submitted field can skip further checks, but no independent missing/empty required-radio rejection was identified in this path. Error increments found there are tied to min/max, character/word length and expression constraints.
server_path_audit.absent_radio_risk: Validation iterates submitted form_data. A completely absent unchecked radio value is not independently proven to be rejected by this generic PHP path.
server_path_audit.rest_route: Entries API routes submission into Action::submit; no separate radio-required server validator was identified in the audited route layer.
server_path_audit.file_validation: core/entries/file-data-validation.php validates file-specific properties only and adds no radio-required enforcement.
server_path_audit.entry_formatting: core/entries/form-data.php formats/stores entry values and adds no identified mf_input_required rejection layer.
server_path_audit.extension_hook: Action::submit applies mf_after_validation_check after built-in validation and rejects the request when the filter returns is_valid=false. This is the same supported extension hook already used by project snippet ID5 for photo-count validation.

current_project_evidence.known_server_extension: Code Snippets ID5: AF MetForm photo count validation, mf_after_validation_check, Form33 route scoped, active/no code error in last verified report.
current_project_evidence.known_ui_extension: Code Snippets ID6: textarea rows parity.
current_project_evidence.live_form_ax: page264 live comparison proves service group label and six radio option names match source, but no submission was performed and no radio input name/required-setting readback was recorded.

mandatory_next_live_read_before_any_vali: Read Form33 current _elementor_data/widget settings around the single #af-form-service radio widget only.
Identify the exact widget ID/type and exact mf_input_name; do not infer the field name from label text.
Read mf_input_required and record whether it is exactly yes.
Confirm the six current option values/order remain source-equivalent.
Do not edit Form33 as part of the page272 package.

page272_server_enforcement_design_gate.reason: D05 requires genuine enforcement, while shared Form33 settings are outside page272-only write scope and the exact service field name is not yet proven.
page272_server_enforcement_design_gate.allowed_future_direction: After the exact field name is read, prepare a separate page272-only validation runtime using mf_after_validation_check with an explicit page272-origin marker/guard and Form33 route guard. Keep it separate from the prepared semantic ID36 v003 update until both ownership and scoping are proven.
must_not: Do not guess the radio field name.
Do not modify shared Form33 settings globally from page272 scope.
Do not add a second competing global Form33 validator without reading existing snippet ID5 and current snippet inventory.
Do not claim server enforcement from the client required flag alone.
Do not perform a real form submission or external delivery test.

conclusion: Client-side native required support exists, but robust server-side enforcement of an absent service radio is not proven in the audited MetForm entry path. The next safe step is a narrow live Form33 settings read to learn the exact service field name and required flag; any page272-only server enforcement must then be designed around the proven mf_after_validation_check hook without changing shared Form33 configuration.
